referenceFunction.generalComment: Covers screwed-laminated timber element, transversally prestressed, for outdoor use, mainly for bridges. The multi-output process "laminated timber element, outdoor use, production" delivers the three coproducts "laminated timber element, transversally prestressed, for outdoor use, at plant", "industrial residue wood, LTE production, softwood, u=20%, at plant" and "industrial residue wood, LTE production, hardwood, u=20%, at plant".
